name: Organization Management
description: Manage organizations and view usage statistics

tasks.description: List all organizations in the system

prompt.template: Query SurrealDB via the activity API to get all organizations. Use the query: SELECT * FROM organization ORDER BY created_at DESC. Display as a data table with columns: ID, Name, Created At, Active Status.
For organization {{orgId}}, query usage statistics including: total API calls, total activity executions, total cost, template success rate. Display as cards or gauges.

variables.name: orgId
variables.description: Organization ID (leave empty to show all orgs)

prompt.template: Query activity execution traces grouped by organization to show which orgs are using which templates most frequently. Display as a grouped bar chart or data table.
Query execution traces to calculate total cost per organization. Show as a pie chart or ranked table. Include: Org Name, Total Cost (USD), Execution Count, Average Cost per Execution.
